module ALU (
    input  wire [31:0] A,
    input  wire [31:0] B,
    input  wire [2:0]  F,      // ALU control: F2:F0
    output reg  [31:0] Y,
    output wire        Zero,
    output wire [31:0] N       // Zero-extended MSB of A
);
    // Zero extender: extract MSB of A and pad with zeros
    assign N = {31'b0, A[31]};
    // Zero flag: true if result is zero
    assign Zero = (Y == 32'b0);
    always @(*) begin
        case (F)
            3'b000: Y = A & B;              // A AND B
            3'b001: Y = A | B;              // A OR B
            3'b010: Y = A + B;              // A + B
            3'b011: Y = A & ~B;             // A AND !B
            3'b100: Y = A | ~B;             // A OR !B
            3'b101: Y = A - B;              // A - B
            3'b110: Y = (A < B) ? 32'd1 : 32'd0; // SLT
            default: Y = 32'b0;             // Unused
        endcase
    end
endmodule

Temporal locality: that if you have used data recently, you are likely to use it again soon (likely to access recent addresses)
Spatial locality: when you use one particular data, you are likely to be interested in other data similar (likely to access addresses close to each other)

Requested data found in cache -> Cache hit, hit rate = (Number of hits)/(number of total mem access)
Requested data not found -> Cache miss, data fetched from memory, miss rate = (Number of miss)/(number of total mem access)
(hit rate) + (miss rate) = 100%
